question: Which of the following is NOT compulsory equipment for a football referee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**White flag**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **White flag** is not a compulsory piece of equipment for a football referee.
 
• Essential equipment for a football referee includes items such as **watch(es), whistle(s), and red and yellow cards**.
 
• These tools help the referee manage the game, keep time, and enforce the rules effectively.
 
• Other non-compulsory items may be used at the referee's discretion but are not mandated by the official regulations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Laws of the Game** are established by the International Football Association Board (IFAB) and specify the required equipment for referees.
 
• Referees must carry a **whistle** to signal the start and stop of play, and **red and yellow cards** to discipline players.
 
• They must also have a **watch** to keep track of the match time and any additional time to be added.
 
• While other items like notebooks, pens, and coin for the toss are commonly used, they are also not strictly compulsory.
